Market today: AI infrastructure is still the narrative, driving tech. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means drawdowns hit hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.39%) and SPAL (-28.23%) are flagged SELL. They are leveraged ETFs and decay is a major concern, especially when down.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any shifts in the AI narrative.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions carefully; they are the biggest risk right now.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting. Leveraged ETFs decay, and the current drawdown is significant.
SPAL: Consider trimming or exiting. Similar to SOXL, the leverage and decay are major risks.
META: Consider adding on weakness if it pulls back towards its 1H order block (660.80-670.64).
